notes.title: Edward's Journey Release Date Set!
notes.content:
[h3] Coming Soon! [/h3]

Finally!  A date has been set for Edward to start his journey.

[h3] January 19th, 2024!  [/h3]  It is right around the corner.  

Help Edward fight through hordes of creepy crawlies as he makes his journey across a beautifully unique world in search of his lost sister.
